composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. creative_direction: Transform a plain wooden thread spool into a squat lighthouse with one small amber glass window. Soft studio illumination reveals painted wood pores against a muted blue-gray field, creating a compact object with steady reassuring character. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
